recommended_path.explicitly_NOT_done_this_task: Wiring fetch_1m_bars() into talonx_quant.consumer.QuantScanner's RollingBarBuffer/buffer_htf (the actual warmup integration point talonx_piv/warmup.py's preseed_and_verify calls into via scanner.preseed_symbols()). This requires: (1) converting Alpaca's 1m bars into whatever RollingBarBuffer.add_bar (or equivalent) expects, (2) deriving the 15m HTF buffer via aggregation (yfinance's preseed.py fetches 15m bars directly from a separate call -- an Alpaca-based replacement would need to either fetch a native 15Min timeframe from the same endpoint, or aggregate 1m bars, and either choice needs correctness review against talonx_quant.indicators.compute_htf_trend's expectations), and (3) deciding whether this becomes the default provider or an env-flagged alternative with yfinance as fallback. None of this touches consumer.py/indicators.py/strategy.py/config.py directly, but it does touch how their inputs are populated, and deserves its own focused task rather than a same-day addition alongside everything else in Task69Q.
